headline: Cube Highways Trust raises ₹1,150 crore through NCDs
summary: Cube Highways Trust has raised ₹1,150 crore by issuing non-convertible debentures carrying a AAA rating. The proceeds from this issuance are earmarked entirely for refinancing existing debt obligations. For Indian retail investors, this transaction highlights how infrastructure investment trusts manage their debt profiles in the domestic bond market.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates Invit debt management and refinancing costs
